name: tt-model-bringup
description: Bring text, computer-vision, and multimodal models to TTNN through category-specific verified stages. Requires tt-autodebug. Codex multigoal setup automatically adds optional telemetry when tenstorrent/ar-dashboard is accessible.

interface.shortDescription: Implement and validate text and vision models on TTNN
interface.longDescription: Bring text, computer-vision, and multimodal models to TTNN through category-specific verified stages. Text keeps the eleven-stage vLLM workflow; vision adds functional-first single-chip bring-up with optional later stages. Requires tt-autodebug.
defaultPrompt: Use model-bringup to classify and bring this model to TTNN.
